info.title: AceData_Veo_Video
info.description: Create videos from text or supported image references with Veo. Retrieve the submitted task and use the finished media URL in the next step. Bind your own Ace Data Cloud credential privately as Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN in Authorization. Usage is billed to your account. Never place a token in chat or shared examples. Start: https://platform.acedata.cloud/?from=coze

post.description: Query the status and result of an asynchronous Veo video task. Pass a task_id to retrieve progress, the video URL, and any error details. Full input requirements: https://platform.acedata.cloud/documents/veo-tasks A non-null response can be a progress snapshot. Require terminal success and a non-empty primary media URL or content, not just a cover image or an empty data array.

parameters.name: accept
parameters.description: The specified server should return the response format as application/json.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Bind your own Ace Data Cloud credential privately as Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN in Authorization. Usage is billed to your account. Never place a token in chat or shared examples.

async.description: Whether to process in asynchronous mode. When set to `true`, the interface immediately returns `task_id`, without the need to provide `callback_url`, and then the result can be obtained by polling the corresponding task query interface; if `callback_url` is also provided, the result will be pushed to that callback address.

model.description: The model used for generating videos has a default value of `veo3-fast`, with an example using `veo31-fast`. If the `resolution` is `4k`, this must be filled with `veo31` (and the `action` must be `text2video`).

action.description: Types of actions for generating videos. `text2video` generates videos based on prompts; `image2video` generates videos based on 1-2 reference images (first frame, or first frame + last frame); `ingredients2video` generates videos based on 1-3 reference images, internally forcing the use of the `veo31-fast-ingredients` model (the model parameter will be ignored under this action); `get1080p` is a deprecated alias for `POST /veo/upsample` (`action=1080p`), retained only for backward compatibility.

video_id.description: The video ID that needs to be referenced is only valid when the action is `get1080p`.

image_urls.description: List of reference image URLs used when generating videos, valid only when the action is `image2video` or `ingredients2video`.

resolution.description: The resolution of the generated video can be `4k`, `1080p`, or `gif`, with the default value being `1080p`. `4k` is only available when `action` is `text2video` and `model` is `veo31`; other combinations will fail during the generation phase.

translation.description: Whether to enable automatic translation of prompts, the default value is `false`.

aspect_ratio.description: Set the aspect ratio of the video output, only supporting `16:9` or `9:16`.

callback_url.description: The callback URL that will be called after the video generation is complete.

post.description: Google Veo AI video generation API. Supports veo2, veo2-fast, veo3, veo3-fast, veo31, veo31-fast, and veo31-fast-ingredients for text-to-video, image-to-video, Full input requirements: https://platform.acedata.cloud/documents/veo-videos Submit once with async=true. Retain task_id and poll the matching task tool; a task ID is not a completed result. Do not resubmit while pending.
